name: RustFS CLI (rc)
description: Installs rc, RustFS's S3 client, from the upstream .deb at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply. There are no default pins.

version.description: rc (rustfs-cli) version to install, without the leading v (e.g. 0.1.36). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_RUSTFS_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256_amd64.description: sha256 of rustfs-cli_<version>_amd64.deb, needed on amd64. Set it here, or as CLI_RUSTFS_SHA256_AMD64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

sha256_arm64.description: sha256 of rustfs-cli_<version>_arm64.deb, needed on arm64. Set it here, or as CLI_RUSTFS_SHA256_ARM64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
